cloud_text_model.description: Cloud text model of the question-only step (Firebase AI Logic, PREFER_IN_CLOUD). The app uses it only if it is a Gemini text model name; otherwise the default in the code stays.

route_mood_words.description: A card made on this computer goes to cloud help for a second opinion when this many of its choices are mood words. Whole number, 1 to 3; anything else is refused by the app.

route_min_choices.description: ... or when it has fewer usable choices than this. Whole number, 2 or 3; anything else is refused by the app.
